findings.text: Gold is still up 26.1% year-on-year, but momentum cooled from +62.7% — a -36.6-point re-rating of the gold-collateral price tailwind.
Chicken swung from +25.6% to -0.6% year-on-year (-26.2 pts) — the livestock-borrower price backdrop turned negative.
Logs momentum faded: 0% year-on-year vs +11.9% last vintage (-11.9 pts).
Sugar is still down 13.5% year-on-year, though the fall moderated from -25.9% (+12.4 pts).
The estimated merchant-demand and collateral-density proxies were flat in every region (largest move 0.1 pt).

findings.short: agri-PD proxy down in all 5 regions
findings.text: The estimated agri-PD proxy eased in all 5 regions, led by North -51.4 pts to 4.3 and Isan -50.9 pts to 5.5.

findings.short: Rubber, Rice, Palm oil prices swung positive
findings.text: Rubber (+45.9 pts to +32.4% YoY), Rice (+37.4 pts to +17.9% YoY) and Palm oil (+35.8 pts to +18.2% YoY) swung from falling to rising prices — the income backdrop for those borrower segments improved.
None of the 80 biggest branch movers got riskier — every one eased, led by เงินไชโย บางลี่ (สุพรรณบุรี) at -41 pts (composite now 51).

headline: Since 2025M12: 3 signals improved and 3 deteriorated — biggest deterioration: Gold price momentum -36.6 pts YoY; biggest improvement: agri-PD proxy down in all 5 regions.

meta.provenance_note: Region and branch figures are ESTIMATED proxies (OSM/price-based, 0-100), not measured defaults. The commodity board is measured/editorial World Bank price direction. Vintage labels come from snapshot metadata, never the wall clock.
meta.source: Digest of platform/data/deltas.json — the diff of two committed data-vintage snapshots built by pipeline/timeseries.py. Every figure in every sentence is read from deltas.json; the wording adds direction/magnitude phrasing only.
